sections.label: Intro
sections.desc: Keys/pad on Ab-Fm-Cm-Bb, no drums, riser in bar 8

sections.label: Verse 1 (no kick)
sections.desc: First vocal at 15.96 s; light percussion, still no kick or sub

sections.label: Verse 1 (kick + sub in)
sections.desc: Four-on-the-floor kick with sub enters on 'alive' at 30.00 s; moonlight line

sections.label: Pre-chorus / build 1
sections.desc: Out of sight, out of mind. Claps every beat, kick filters out after 50.6 s, 8th roll bars 29-30, 16th roll bars 31-32

sections.label: Drop 1 / chorus
sections.desc: Impact 60.000 s on 'kicks us OUT'. Rolling sidechained bass, offbeat open hats, vocal chops

sections.label: Breakdown
sections.desc: Kick stops after the 105.000 s hit. 'Grooving till the bar kicks us out / oh, oh' over keys. Most intimate moment

sections.label: Verse 2 (bridge lyric)
sections.desc: Kick back at 120.00 s, no claps. 'Shoot for the stars...' then 'We rise and we fall, living forever young'

sections.label: Pre-chorus / build 2
sections.desc: Same build shape as build 1, kick out after 155.6 s, rolls into drop 2

sections.label: Drop 2 / final chorus
sections.desc: Impact 165.000 s. Kick drops out for bar 104 (193.1-195.0) and bar 112 (208.1-210.0). Strongest section

sections.label: Outro
sections.desc: Last hit 210.000 s, keys and shaker fade, silence at ~226 s

events.note: riser tail into first percussion bar
kick filtered out, tension without a floor
sub pickup on beat 4 of bar 32
vocal chop phrase leading into second half of drop
last kick, drop 1 collapses into breakdown
after 'backs to the sun', 2.2 s with no vocal
kick drops out for one bar inside drop 2 (bar 104)
final vocal phrase over the end of drop 2
